failure: Failure: These are necessary shape conditions, not a characterization or identification of dark energy. An acceptable BAO-only fit does not resolve DESI+CMB+supernova comparisons and is not a new law. The numerical values remain source-reported and unverified by this intake.
interface: Interface: Assumes flat homogeneous GR, separate conservation, barotropic pressure response, the stated null-energy and causal sound-speed bounds, and the source’s DESI DR2 compressed radial-distance likelihood. Does not cover interacting fluids, all scalar-field models, modified gravity, or non-flat cosmology.

claims.title: A causal separately conserved barotropic-fluid model constrains the shape of H squared
